signal: Symplast is rolling out AI-driven patient engagement features like automated follow-ups and predictive scheduling across 3,500+ aesthetic users

email.body1:
Lisa, saw Symplast leaning into AI-driven patient engagement across your 3,500-plus aesthetic users.

The same lag that hurts patient follow-up usually shows up in sales: signals come in faster than the team can act on them, and pipeline leaks in the gap. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, personalized outreach automatically, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Symplast off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lisa, quick follow-up for Symplast.

For revops, the bottleneck is rarely intent data, it is the time between a signal firing and a rep acting on it. Structure compounds the loss: tighter 75-100 word emails alone tend to lift reply rates 67%, and most teams never measure it.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change, and our best practices that usually lift response rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Lisa, last bit of proof for Symplast.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Symplast's reply rate likely compares to other healthcare software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Lisa, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If closing the signal-to-action gap is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and rolling out new engagement features is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a revops team? I will tailor it to Symplast either way.
